name: bar-do-guto
description: Sistema de gestão do Bar do Guto (PDV, cozinha, entregas, caixa, estoque, WhatsApp e cardápio digital)

scripts.dev: npm run dev -w @guto/server & npm run dev -w @guto/web
scripts.build: npm run build -w @guto/web && npm run build -w @guto/server
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/core && tsc -p apps/server && tsc -p apps/web
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:integration
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build && tsx scripts/e2e-reset.mts && playwright test
